exec: pm.test("POST persisted",()=>{const o=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.orchidName).to.eql("Postman Lab4 Orchid"); pm.expect(String(o.orchidCategory.categoryId)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("categoryId"))); pm.expect(o.isNatural).to.eql(true); pm.expect(o.orchidCategory).not.to.have.property("orchids");});

pm.test("PUT persisted",()=>{const o=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.orchidName).to.eql("Postman Lab4 Orchid Updated"); pm.expect(o.isNatural).to.eql(false); pm.expect(o.isAttractive).to.eql(false); pm.expect(String(o.orchidCategory.categoryId)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("secondCategoryId")));});
pm.test("Rejected PUT preserved state",()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().orchidName).to.eql("Postman Lab4 Orchid Updated"));
